Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the river binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 153 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
